_comment_dataRoot: Where YOUR timesheet data lives (activity-log.md + raw/). Written by install.ps1. If sync.enabled, this is <sync.repoRoot>\timesheet.
_comment_machine: Identifies this computer in raw/<machine>/. Defaults to $env:COMPUTERNAME.
_comment_time: timezoneOffsetHours = your local UTC offset (Bangkok = 7). idleCapMinutes = a gap longer than this counts as 'away', not work.
_comment_lastSubmitted: Date of the last timesheet you already submitted (YYYY-MM-DD). The session banner offers to backfill days after it. Leave "" to disable the offer.
_comment_sync: enabled/repoRoot are written by install.ps1. extraPaths are additional repo-relative paths sync-push commits alongside the timesheet - use it when the data repo also carries something else you want on every machine. Left empty, nothing outside dataRoot is ever touched.
_comment_update: Daily check for a newer version of these tools. When the upstream branch has a commit this clone doesn't, the SessionStart banner says so. checkEveryHours throttles the network call; repo defaults to the clone's origin. Set enabled false to never phone home.
_comment_projects: Maps a working directory to a short project name, first match wins. 'match' is a case-insensitive regex tested against the full lowercased path. No match -> the folder name is used.
_comment_git: Used when backfilling from git history. authorPattern is passed to `git log --author`; searchRoots are scanned for repos; hostMap turns a remote host into a project short name.
